first.rationale: Prioritize simplification because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields durably improve completion, time-to-value, and early activation. This supports sustainable qualified revenue more directly than matching competitor pricing, which previously harmed retention. Verify the two most directly relevant source records before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening the self-serve onboarding flow, prioritizing removal of nonessential steps after signup rather than a broad pricing response. The verified onboarding result showed completion +13%, time-to-value down 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing both current declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Limit initial targeting to self-serve/SMB-relevant traffic and monitor qualified revenue and 30-day retention: signup simplification improved SMB outcomes but had a 1% retention decline and has not been replicated outside SMB. Do not use promotional pricing because prior evidence found material 30-day retention harm despite acquisition gains.
